items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section III, List of Answers on Topics 18:1
items.html: For five records remained in Malchut from her lights in Ein Sof, even after the restriction. For there the light of Ein Sof completely filled phase four, and she received there all the light that was fit for her five phases. And since the screen now detains all that light which is fit to fill these records, it turns out that there are five phases in this reflected light — Keter, Hochma, Bina, Tifferet and Malchut — which are rejected from the five records in Malchut. And know that these five phases in the reflected light are the ones that ascend and clothe the five phases in the direct light. (Inner Observation, Chapter 2, Item 2)
